name: Pemo
description: Pemo is the financial OS for UAE SMBs — corporate cards, bill pay, and treasury in one platform. This connector gives Claude secure, read-only access to your Pemo data: query transactions, cards, team members, and reimbursements directly in conversation, with support for filtering, grouping, and summarizing results. No data is created, approved, or modified — Claude only reads and reports on what's already in your account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pemo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pemo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pemo.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pemo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pemo provides these MCP tools: pemo_list_cards, pemo_list_members, pemo_list_organizations, pemo_list_reimbursements, pemo_list_transactions, and pemo_whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pemo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pemo in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Pemo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pemo is developed by Pemo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
